protocol.stock_scope: Current pinned Freerouting2.5 JAR/DSN/SES path with no adapter; official IPC/native binaries unmeasured.
protocol.stronger_scope: Separate installed experimental free-angle/disabled fanout/disabled optimizer/clearance20/original-global-width route with via_default; same budget. No ordinaryGUI/CLI free-angle option claim.
protocol.task: Same immutable original whole-unlocked task, original nets/terminals/geometry/settings/stackup/rules/severities/exclusions/zones and locked routes unchanged. Actual independent Native proof and fresh export required for every deliveredcandidate.
protocol.primary_outcome: Complete actual Native-validated separate-project delivery within complete wall and parent+waited-child CPU240 and routing/selection method120; false acceptance forbidden.
protocol.quality: Report raw opens/blocking/warnings/exclusions, full findings/ignoredchecks, native length/vias on common valid outputs; no electrical/cleanup inference. Fixed portfolio rank is vias then length then attempt index.
protocol.failure_policy: Preserve every failed/unsupported/over-budget/cancelled/unattempted arm and variant. Original source conflicts distinct from routing failures; expected unconnected source nets are not invalid source designs. No per-board/source/algorithm changes during this fixedrun.
protocol.accounting: Enclosing runner/time captures every start/import/conversion/attempt/selection/readback/review/render/testintent/fresh validation/delivery/publication through real exit. Inner fields sampled before tails are not complete invocation costs. Cold setup/research/authoring/test/review costs recorded separately.

rights.scope: All demos/* per exact retained sourceLICENSE.README; notices in unchanged16file originalpacket. Only owned code/smallhash+diagnostic evidence pushed, no boardpayloads.

protocol.development_failure_link: Prior stronger cohort delivered Sonde B2_stronger but lost C delivery under full original constraints. Curated runtime/helper pipeline now removes research-archive dependency and checks actual final failed attempts. Compare installed completion/quality/budget without assuming historical Native results recur.
protocol.claims_limit: One already exposed family, no general completion superiority/untouched confirmation/electrical or human approval. Published engine performance claims not reproduced here.

prior_incomplete_setup.reason: External enclosure omitted new output parent; B0 exited before preview/native; other arms unattempted. New complete five-arm run, no stitching.
